comment: Organisation names from the Bundestag's published side-job declarations that are the same body
as a Lobbyregister entry but cannot be matched automatically: build-lobby-links.mjs links only
on the exact normalised name, or on the same name with every bracketed part removed.
Every entry is an assertion of identity, so add one only after opening both the declaration and
the register entry and confirming they are the same legal body - not a member, branch or sister
organisation. An unknown register id fails the build.

aliases.evidence: Register entry R002126 lists Christian Haase as Präsident and legal representative; his declaration names the same office (Präsident ab 17.06.2025). Checked 2026-11-12.
